instruction: A candid outdoor medium shot of two children posing together in a sunny park. The boy in a blue denim shirt (R5) stands on the left with his arm around the shoulder of the girl with bangs in a dark blue cardigan over a striped dress (R4) on the right. Both children smile warmly towards the camera. Bright sunlight filters through the green trees behind them, creating a soft sun flare, a warm, natural color palette, and a shallow depth of field.
